reviewScope: Static adversarial review of synthetic fixture preparation, coverage, frozen assertions, and progress consistency only. This is not T11 behavior acceptance.

coverage.p01ThroughP28: Each P fixture is referenced once; all remain NOT_RUN.
coverage.controlledTextAndImage: Dedicated disposable receivers and synthetic payloads are planned; target observation is required, and image format/receiver specifics remain OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.trayAndMultiMonitor: Hide/show and warm wake, plus a controlled two-monitor layout, are planned; activation and topology policies remain OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.permissionsAndCopyOnly: Capability-driven copy fallback and higher-integrity/focus failure safety are covered; exact Windows reason/result mapping and wording remain OPEN_QUESTION.
coverage.backgroundLifecycle: A synthetic clipboard capture and bounded repository operation while the WebView is hidden/detached are planned; no crash-durability claim is made before T07.
coverage.shutdownLifecycle: The fixture now limits its stated shutdown cases to the idle-worker and cancellable pre-commit states it actually supplies.
coverage.performance: Wake, normal text, and full-process L0 comparison fixtures use fixed-environment inputs, at least 100 normal samples, requestId correlation, per-process monotonic timing, and the frozen 08 §4 summary reporting rules.

reviewFindings.detail: Paste modifier, focus, cancellation, and opening-guard assertions reference docs/spec/limits.v1.json fields instead of shadowing their numeric values in fixture text.
The hidden-panel lifecycle case now includes synthetic clipboard capture and repository work independent of WebView visibility.
T09 has not frozen imageWorkerPeakBytes allocation categories or measurement method. P17 keeps numeric peak acceptance NOT_RUN and explicitly gates it on that decision.

The plan follows 08 §4 for at least 100 normal samples and p50/p95/max/failure reporting. Full-process numeric thresholds, exact physical-memory metric/attribution, and sampling duration remain OPEN_QUESTION.

notPerformed: Production implementation or generated contract changes
Behavior tests, fake-platform execution, packaging, or builds
Windows desktop, clipboard, tray, monitor, permission, or input operations
limitations: All T11 behavior and performance results remain NOT_RUN; dependencies are not accepted.
The image worker peak-memory measurement method is gated on T09.
This independent review validates fixture-plan preparation only and does not accept T11.
